svg.title: Cell masks select pixels for named intensity measurements
svg.desc: Four views of one illustrative full-resolution raster show the cell mask, nucleus mask, cell minus nucleus and the one-pixel four-connected cell border. The membrane test compares the cell pixel with its existing north, south, east and west neighbours. A selected cytoplasm mask gathers values from one schematic channel M, and their mean is written under the compartment, channel and statistic name for that cell. The raster and values are symbolic; no observed cell shape or biological intensity pattern is depicted.
